speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I did not agree to trade data consistency for a manual step, I said a manual step is acceptable only if it guarantees that consistency. You cannot treat my note as a blanket permission to skip versioning checks just to save time.
output.correction: I am not talking about the model retraining schedule, I am talking about the raw point of sale scan lines feeding the forecast. If you do not pin the exact data version used for each nightly run, you cannot debug why a specific store got a bad order suggestion.
